Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

yesterday — the day before today. Example: Yesterday I worked at home.
last — the one before this one. Example: Last week I worked every day.
week — seven days. Example: I worked last week.
work — to do a job. Example: I worked yesterday.
visit — to go to see a person or place. Example: I visited my mother.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Yesterday I ...
• Last week I ...
• I visited ...
• What did you do yesterday?
• I finished at six.

Grammar focus: Past Simple (regular & irregular verbs).
Use the past simple for finished actions: I worked yesterday. I visited my friend last week. Regular verbs add -ed.
